scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && pnpm dev:prepare && turbo run dev --no-cache
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @repo/backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @repo/backend prisma:deploy && pnpm --filter @repo/backend prisma:seed
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v
scripts.validate: pnpm check-types && pnpm exec prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,md}" && pnpm --filter @repo/backend test:cov
